integrations.name: PostgreSQL
integrations.description: Persistent event records, registrations, attendance, and audit history.

integrations.name: Clerk authentication
integrations.description: Managed sign-in. Application roles enforced by the server.

integrations.name: LiveKit
integrations.description: Requires a LiveKit server, API credentials and a tested media session. Preferred adapter for fine-grained permissions.

integrations.name: Jitsi Meet
integrations.description: Alternative embedded meeting provider. Not configured or tested; no media sessions available.

integrations.name: Ollama local inference
integrations.description: Requires an authenticated, securely networked external inference server. No local GPU or AI inference is connected.

integrations.name: Real-time translation
integrations.description: Speech-to-text → translation → captions → private voice output. Requires consent and tested providers.

integrations.name: SimpleX Chat
integrations.description: Private administrator-to-presenter messaging adapter is not connected.

integrations.name: Kubernetes
integrations.description: No cluster configured. No infrastructure actions are executed.

integrations.name: Isolated latency demonstration
integrations.description: Real timer measurements with rule-based analysis and administrator approval. Not LLM inference or production infrastructure.

agents.name: AI SRE Agent
agents.description: Measure a controlled delay, inspect evidence, request approval, reset the safe demo delay and verify recovery. Rule-based demonstration, not an AI model.

agents.name: Event Operations Agent
agents.description: Activity analysis, attendance summaries and announcement drafts.

agents.name: Presenter Assistant Agent
agents.description: Question organization, session summaries, decisions and action items.

agents.name: Translation Agent
agents.description: Multilingual transcription, captions, translation and voice output.
